rules.explanation: Use a direct bounded tool when it fully covers the request.
Unknown tool capability cannot be treated as supported.
Expose only task-relevant tools with purpose, use conditions, typed returns, and errors stated.
Resolve prerequisite discovery, retrieval, and validation first; parallelize independent reads and sequence dependent actions.
Synthesize bounded read results once before acting; do not repeat completed work or silently change routes.
Retrieve only evidence needed for the current decision and cite its sanitized source.
For ordinary questions, begin with one broad search using short discriminative terms.
Retrieve again only for a missing required fact, owner, date, identifier, source, unread artifact, exhaustive request, or unsupported material claim.
Cite only retrieved evidence at supported claims; label inference, conflicts, missing evidence, and creative wording.
PTC routing requires an observed supported host capability.
Use PTC only for bounded deterministic read-only transforms with exact schemas, evidence, concurrency, retry, stop, and one handoff limits.
Keep one-call, small-output, judgment-changing, approval, citation, native-artifact, side-effecting, and final-validation work direct.
